packageRules.description: GitHub Actions are SHA-pinned with a version comment (see root CLAUDE.md). Renovate has no releaseTimestamp for a bare commit SHA, so the shared preset's `minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour: timestamp-required` holds action digest PRs in `renovate/stability-days` PENDING indefinitely and they never auto-merge (e.g. #52/#80 stuck 15-21 days past the window). Drop the age gate for github-actions digest/pinDigest updates only; the SHA pin + human-readable version comment is the supply-chain control for actions. npm/docker age gates are unaffected.
